# よむ (Yomu)

> よむ is a free, open-source pop-up dictionary for learning Japanese. Press a word on a web page, in a YouTube subtitle, in a manga panel, in a PDF, or on your desktop screen to see its reading, meaning, pitch accent, audio, and example sentences, then save it with its sentence and review it.

## Primary Links

- [Homepage](https://yomureader.com/): Product overview and install entry point.
- [Start here](https://yomureader.com/learn/): Install guide for Chrome, Edge, Brave, Vivaldi, Opera, Firefox, Safari, iPhone and iPad, then a first lookup.
- [Desktop app](https://yomureader.com/desktop): Download for Windows, macOS and Linux to read Japanese anywhere on screen, including games.
- [FAQ](https://yomureader.com/faq): Plain answers about cost, reviews, apps, and data.
- [Install userscript](https://yomureader.com/yomu.user.js): Current production userscript.
- [Source code](https://github.com/HRussellZFAC023/yomu-reader): MIT-licensed project repository.

## Guide

- [Reading](https://yomureader.com/learn/reading): Popup lookup, furigana, pitch accent, kanji drilldown, and PDFs.
- [Watching](https://yomureader.com/learn/watching): Subtitle lookup, transcript, shadowing, batch mining, and YouTube filtering.
- [Manga and games](https://yomureader.com/learn/manga-and-games): Manga and image OCR.
- [Save and review](https://yomureader.com/learn/keeping-words): Saving words with their sentences and reviewing them in Study.
- [Optional setup](https://yomureader.com/learn/your-own-setup): Dictionaries, audio, Anki, Jiten, Bunpro, JPDB, WaniKani, and device sync.

## Apps

- [Study](https://yomureader.com/study/): Offline-first review app.
- [Video player](https://yomureader.com/video-player/): Local video and subtitle files.
- [PDF reader](https://yomureader.com/pdf-reader/): Local PDFs, scanned pages included.
- [API reference](https://yomureader.com/api/): OpenAPI contracts for Yomu services.

## Crawling Notes

- Public docs and apps are crawlable.
- Internal engineering ADRs and strategy notes are not published as docs pages.
- Canonical domain: https://yomureader.com/
- Sitemap: https://yomureader.com/sitemap.xml
- Robots: https://yomureader.com/robots.txt
